title: Fix chapter export to PDF/DOCX failing with 'export failed'

requirements.text: Fix the backend export APIs so exporting a chapter as PDF or DOCX succeeds for both empty and non-empty chapters and returns a downloadable binary payload to the frontend.

quotes: ta podstawowa funkcja czyli eksport do pdf lub docx nie dział , po kliknięciu w obu przypadkach jest ten sam komunikat  export failed
Pobiera się około 3 sekundy i nic nie pobiera , nawet uszkodzonego pliku

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the backend method used by the UI to export a chapter as PDF returns non-empty bytes for an empty chapter and for a chapter with text formatting.
Calling the backend method used by the UI to export a chapter as DOCX returns non-empty bytes for an empty chapter and for a chapter with text formatting.
If a chapter contains canister-stored image attachments, the exported PDF embeds the image bytes (no external links).
If a chapter contains canister-stored image attachments, the exported DOCX embeds the image bytes (no external links).
Backend export failures return a clear, debuggable error (not a silent failure) so the frontend can display an actionable message.

requirements.text: Fix the frontend export flow in the chapter editor so clicking “Export PDF” or “Export DOCX” reliably triggers a file download, and improve error reporting so the user is not left with a generic 'export failed' when the backend call fails.

quotes: po kliknięciu w obu przypadkach jest ten sam komunikat  export failed

acceptanceCriteria: From the chapter edit view, clicking “Export PDF” downloads a .pdf file for an empty chapter and for a chapter with content.
From the chapter edit view, clicking “Export DOCX” downloads a .docx file for an empty chapter and for a chapter with content.
The export UI indicates exporting state and prevents repeated clicks while an export is in progress (no duplicate requests).
If export fails, the toast/error message shown to the user is in English and includes a short reason derived from the thrown error (while still being safe to display).
The downloaded files have sanitized filenames based on the chapter title (as currently implemented via sanitizeFilename).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
nonGoals: Adding new export formats beyond PDF and DOCX.
Changing authentication (must continue using Internet Identity).
Adding real-time progress streaming for export beyond the existing exporting state.
